text.title: Switch from supermarket shopping to FreshDrop: 52 interviews, May 2026
text.current: Supermarket visits and a paper list
text.push: Queues and no time to shop: 64% of switchers
text.pull: Delivery in 2 hours and lower prices: 58%
text.habit: Habit of checking produce in person: 41%
text.anxiety: Fear of wrong items and bad produce: 35%
text.balance: Push and pull outweigh habit and anxiety: 52% of trial users switched within 2 weeks
text.decision: Weaken anxiety with a produce guarantee; expect 60% switch rate; check in 4 weeks
